description: FamilySearch tree person read for Patrick Flynn — the isolated case: no relatives, no attached source descriptions. Shape follows person-read-tool-spec.md's Output section: the top level is always { persons, relationships, sources }, never a bare person object. Facts carry both sidecars the tool emits (`standard_place` from the place resolver, `standard_date` from stdDate), and neither is a string copy of its raw field — FamilySearch standardized names drop "County" and stdDate renders `~1845` as `Abt 1845` — so a run that re-derives either instead of keeping what the tool returned is visible in the written tree. The predicate requires BOTH flags: person_read defaults them to false, and a call that omits either gets fixture_not_found and is scored down on Tool Arguments rather than silently receiving the payload it did not ask for.
